config.$comment: Every number that shapes a rating lives here. Edit, then run `npm run compute` (or wait for the next scheduled update). Weights inside a group are relative; group weights must add up to 1.

shrinkage.$comment: Low-volume numbers are pulled toward the league average: shrunk = (value*n + leagueAvg*prior) / (n + prior), where n is the volume basis (season totals). Removes the 1-for-1 = 100% problem.

hustle.label: Hustle
hustle.definition: Hustle: energetic, determined effort. Measured as how often a player creates extra possessions through effort plays that don't show up as steals or rebounds.

screening.label: Screening & off-ball
screening.definition: Screen: a legal block that frees a teammate. Off-ball work: what a player does for others without the ball. Measured by screens that lead directly to a teammate's basket and by box-outs.

defense.label: Defensive impact
defense.definition: Defend: to make it harder for the opponent to score. Measured as how much worse opponents shoot when this player is the closest defender, compared with those same shooters' normal accuracy.

DFG_DIFF.label: Opponent FG% vs normal (lower is better)

creation.label: Shot creation
creation.definition: Create: to bring something about by one's own action. Measured as the share of made shots nobody assisted, and points generated from driving to the basket.

clutch.label: Clutch
clutch.definition: Clutch: performing well under pressure. Measured in the last five minutes of games within five points: scoring efficiency and the team's net rating with the player on the floor.

onOff.label: On-court impact
onOff.definition: Impact: a marked effect. Measured as the team's net rating with the player on the floor minus its net rating with the player off it.
